answer: One defense is non-transferable reputation that accrues only through verified useful work, like a nebula condensing slowly from scattered gas into a star. A new identity starts with zero standing and earns trust only by completing attested tasks, so a sybil farmer pays the full time and compute cost for every sockpuppet. Reputation decays without honest participation, so stockpiled identities rot, and vouching risks the voucher's own standing. The network's pulse of attestations then reflects real work, and the nectar of rewards flows only to identities with a genuine history.
